name: @coding-adventures/forme-doc-frontmatter
description: Strip YAML or TOML frontmatter from a markdown source string.  Returns { body, frontmatter }.  Tiny safe parser (no eval, no prototype pollution); supports the docs-frontmatter subset (scalars, dates as strings, flat arrays of scalars, flat maps).  Rejects malformed input.  DOC00 v0 content-pipeline package.
author: Adhithya Rajasekaran
